P-x43a.my_guess: CEILING, WEAKLY (against the lab lean; PARTIAL-MARGIN-AT-HEIGHT the registered runner-up)
P-x43a.registered: GROUNDS: (1) DOSE-EXHAUSTION — the varied pool is a FIXED 300-window set drawn ~16x/step at constant 1e-3: by s300 every window has been visited ~16 times; e341's own trajectory shows the read EQUILIBRATED by ~s50 (s25 0.684, s50 0.803, then a 0.31-0.80 bounce band with no trend through s300), and the cons's 300->0.90 was calibrated on a subject with a 1000-step install history behind it, not a fresh install. (2) HEIGHT-MARGIN DECOUPLING — x39's HEIGHT-CLAUSE-STANDS: the controller's composed retention was FLAT 0.10-0.16 across t400-t800 (steps beyond 400 bought NOTHING once the read plateaued ~0.87), and e340's arm at cons-class height (0.873, fixed contexts) composed BELOW e341's 0.752 arm (0.130 vs 0.244): composed retention has never tracked raw read-height past the first tranche. (3) THE PRECEDENT LADDER — 0.045 -> 0.130 -> 0.244 flattens in relative terms (2.9x, 1.9x); the band needs 3.9x the last step. COUNTERVAILING (equal force): (a) the panel read is a LOTTERY SAMPLE (e341's s275 0.576 -> s300 0.752 in 25 steps) — a 900-step boundary could draw >= 0.9 by luck, and the cons proves this lineage CAN sit at ~0.90 under this protocol at its own subject state; (b) the retention axis has only ever been probed at ONE varied dose (300 steps) — 'retention saturates' is a one-point extrapolation, and the varied-context channel (x40's directional armor + support breadth) is the one axis the controller family never had; (c) under the frozen composite a shallow monotone rise WITH a stalled t0 still reads CEILING (the t0 clause takes precedence) — my guess leans on the t0 axis specifically.
P-x43a.predicted_shape: the anneal climbs slowly and saturates: t0(600) 0.72-0.85, t0(900) 0.75-0.88 — under 0.9 with the 600->900 climb < 0.05; the composed retention curve 0.244 (the replication anchor) -> 0.25-0.40 -> 0.25-0.45 (improvement within noise, monotone-ish but shallow, well under the band); the bare matched-anneal control dies at s1 (<= 0.05, the e335/e341 bare precedent)
P-x43a.falsifier: t0(900) >= 0.9 (the anneal buys cons height — PARTIAL/BAND live); the composed retention lands in [0.957, 1.088] (BAND-REACHED); or the retention rises > 0.02 per leg while the t0 keeps climbing (PARTIAL's monotone clause with the ceiling clause dead)
